statuses_defined.EVIDENCE_CONFIRMED: Supported by direct source of declared level; cite exact SHA/path/anchor.
statuses_defined.UNKNOWN_IN_CHECKED_SOURCES: No original evidence located in checked Git/Drive/Library scope; not a global no-existence claim.
statuses_defined.UNVERIFIABLE_ORIGINAL: An archived outcome exists but independent original execution cannot be established.
statuses_defined.DISPOSITION_DOCUMENTED: Unknown is bounded and explicitly recorded; no claim of original authenticity.
statuses_defined.INDEPENDENT_PASS: Only distinct signed reviewer can certify editorial acceptability of bounded unknowns.
